title: Semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in adults with obesity without diabetes
abstract_text: In a randomized trial, semaglutide reduced major adverse cardiovascular events among adults with overweight or obesity without diabetes.

title: Large language models for clinical note summarization: a multicenter evaluation
abstract_text: We evaluated LLM-based summarization across three health systems and report accuracy, safety, and clinician preferences.
full_text: We benchmarked LLM note summarization on de-identified inpatient notes across three sites. Human review found high utility but recurring medication dose errors, mitigated by structured prompts and verification steps.

title: Global burden of long COVID: systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract_text: We synthesize prevalence and symptom duration estimates for post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection across settings.

title: Wastewater surveillance detects emerging SARS-CoV-2 lineages ahead of clinical reporting
abstract_text: Sequencing of wastewater samples identified lineage transitions 2-3 weeks before increases in clinical test positivity.
full_text: Across 14 sewersheds, wastewater sequencing tracked lineage turnover and detected growth of emerging variants before clinic data. Lead time varied with flow and sampling frequency; normalization improved comparability.

title: Association of ultra-processed food intake with incident depression: a prospective cohort study
abstract_text: Higher ultra-processed food intake was associated with increased risk of incident depression after adjustment for confounders.

title: Global patterns of antimicrobial resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae from 2010 to 2022
abstract_text: We analyzed public genomes and susceptibility datasets to map trends in AMR determinants and high-risk clones worldwide.
full_text: We combined surveillance and genomic datasets to describe AMR trends in K. pneumoniae. ESBL and carbapenemase markers rose in multiple regions, with repeated introductions of high-risk sequence types into new settings.

title: A fast approximate nearest-neighbor index for protein embeddings at billion-scale
abstract_text: We introduce an ANN index optimized for protein embedding search with improved recall-latency tradeoffs on large catalogs.

title: Single-cell atlas of human lung macrophages across health and viral pneumonia
abstract_text: We profile lung macrophage states across healthy donors and viral pneumonia to identify conserved inflammatory programs.
full_text: scRNA-seq of bronchoalveolar cells revealed distinct alveolar and monocyte-derived macrophage programs. Viral pneumonia expanded interferon-stimulated states and a metallothionein-high cluster linked to severity.

title: Coronaviruses: cross-species transmission and pandemic risk
abstract_text: We review determinants of coronavirus spillover, including host range, ecology, and surveillance gaps relevant to pandemic preparedness.

title: CRISPR base editing corrects a pathogenic HBB variant in primary human hematopoietic stem cells
abstract_text: Adenine base editing achieved efficient correction of an HBB pathogenic variant in primary HSCs with limited off-target activity.
full_text: In primary CD34+ cells, ABE corrected an HBB mutation with high editing rates and preserved engraftment in xenografts. Off-target analysis showed few candidate sites, reduced further by engineered deaminase variants.

title: Structure-guided design of broad sarbecovirus neutralizing antibodies
abstract_text: Structural mapping enabled design and optimization of antibodies with breadth across sarbecoviruses and improved neutralization potency.

title: Preprint: Multimodal foundation models for pathology slide interpretation
abstract_text: We describe a multimodal model combining whole-slide images and text supervision for tumor classification and biomarker prediction.
full_text: We trained a multimodal pathology model with weak supervision and paired text. Across external cohorts, performance generalized for subtyping and mutation status, with attention maps highlighting tumor regions and artifacts.

title: Effectiveness of bivalent mRNA boosters against symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infection: a test-negative study
abstract_text: In a test-negative design, bivalent boosters increased protection against symptomatic infection compared with prior monovalent vaccination.
full_text: Using linked national testing and vaccination data, bivalent boosters provided added protection vs prior doses. Effectiveness waned over months but remained higher in older adults and those with comorbidities.

title: Polygenic risk scores for coronary artery disease across diverse ancestries
abstract_text: We evaluate CAD polygenic scores across ancestries and identify calibration issues that affect clinical transferability.

title: Mitochondrial quality control in neurodegeneration: mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities
abstract_text: We review mitophagy, fission-fusion dynamics, and mitochondrial proteostasis in neurodegeneration, highlighting druggable nodes.
full_text: This review summarizes pathways controlling mitochondrial turnover and repair, including PINK1-Parkin signaling, receptor-mediated mitophagy, and the integrated stress response. We discuss small molecules targeting these routes in models.

title: A universal influenza vaccine candidate elicits cross-group neutralizing antibodies in humans
mesh_terms: Clinical Trials, Phase I as Topic
abstract_text: A phase 1 study of a chimeric HA vaccine induced broadly neutralizing antibodies with acceptable reactogenicity.

title: Predictors of response to anti-PD-1 therapy across solid tumors: a pan-cancer analysis
abstract_text: Tumor mutational burden, interferon signaling, and antigen presentation features jointly predicted response to anti-PD-1 across cohorts.
full_text: We analyzed multiple immunotherapy cohorts and found response associated with neoantigen load and intact antigen presentation. Composite models outperformed single biomarkers, but performance varied by histology and assay platform.

title: Effect of digital CBT for insomnia delivered via smartphone: randomized controlled trial
abstract_text: A fully remote digital CBT-I program improved insomnia severity and sleep efficiency compared with education control.
full_text: Participants receiving digital CBT-I showed greater reductions in ISI scores and improved sleep efficiency at 8 weeks. Engagement metrics correlated with outcomes; adverse events were uncommon and mild.

title: Host genetic determinants of severe RSV infection in infants
abstract_text: Genome-wide analyses identified loci associated with hospitalization for RSV in infants and highlighted innate immune pathways.

title: Sepsis bundles and outcomes in community hospitals: an interrupted time series analysis
abstract_text: Implementation of sepsis bundles was associated with changes in antibiotic timing and lactate testing, with modest outcome shifts.

title: Intermittent fasting and metabolic health: a systematic review of randomized trials
abstract_text: Randomized trials suggest intermittent fasting produces modest weight loss and improves insulin sensitivity, with variable adherence.
full_text: Across randomized trials, intermittent fasting reduced weight and improved some metabolic markers compared with controls. Effects varied by regimen and baseline BMI; adherence and dropout were common limitations.

title: Retracted: Effects of curcumin on inflammatory markers in rheumatoid arthritis
abstract_text: This record is marked as retracted by the publisher; content is not cached beyond bibliographic metadata.

title: Senolytic therapy in aging mice improves physical function but alters immune composition
abstract_text: Senolytic treatment improved grip strength and treadmill endurance in aged mice while shifting myeloid and T cell proportions.

title: Open dataset: de-identified ICU waveform segments for arrhythmia detection
abstract_text: We release an open ICU waveform subset with labels for arrhythmia events to support benchmarking and reproducible research.
full_text: We describe a de-identified ICU waveform dataset with curated arrhythmia annotations and standardized train/test splits. Baseline models and evaluation scripts are provided to facilitate comparisons across methods.

title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals immune niches associated with response to checkpoint blockade in melanoma
abstract_text: Spatial profiling identified T cell-enriched niches linked to response to checkpoint blockade and suggested macrophage-mediated resistance programs.
full_text: Spatial transcriptomics in pretreatment melanoma biopsies highlighted T cell-rich neighborhoods associated with response. Resistant tumors showed myeloid niches expressing suppressive cytokines and antigen presentation deficits.

title: Neutralizing antibody durability after XBB.1.5 infection and bivalent vaccination
abstract_text: Neutralization titers against contemporary variants declined over 6 months, with higher durability after hybrid immunity.

title: Frailty trajectories and hospitalization risk in older adults: a longitudinal study
journal: J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci
abstract_text: Distinct frailty trajectories were associated with differential hospitalization risk, supporting early identification and targeted prevention.

title: Metformin remodels gut microbiota to improve insulin sensitivity in prediabetes
abstract_text: Metformin use was associated with reproducible microbiome shifts and metabolite changes linked to improved insulin sensitivity.
full_text: In a prediabetes cohort, metformin altered gut microbial composition and increased short-chain fatty acid pathways. Mediation analyses suggested microbiome-derived metabolites contributed to improved insulin sensitivity.

title: A randomized trial of inclisiran in patients with high-risk atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease
abstract_text: Inclisiran lowered LDL cholesterol substantially with infrequent dosing; safety signals were comparable to placebo in this trial.

title: Benchmarking single-cell RNA-seq integration methods on curated multi-batch datasets
abstract_text: We benchmark integration methods for scRNA-seq, highlighting tradeoffs between batch correction and conservation of biological variation.
full_text: Using curated multi-batch scRNA-seq datasets, we assessed integration tools for alignment, clustering, and differential expression. No single method dominated; performance depended on cell type overlap and batch confounding.

title: An updated human gene catalog with improved annotation of long noncoding RNAs
abstract_text: We present a revised human gene catalog with expanded lncRNA annotation, improved transcript evidence, and updated identifiers for interoperability.

title: Sleep deprivation impairs glymphatic clearance and increases tau accumulation in mice
abstract_text: Chronic sleep restriction reduced glymphatic influx and was associated with increased tau burden in mouse brain regions.

title: Continuous glucose monitoring in non–insulin-treated type 2 diabetes: a pragmatic trial
abstract_text: In routine care, CGM use improved time in range and reduced HbA1c compared with usual care in adults with type 2 diabetes not using insulin.
full_text: In a pragmatic trial, adults with type 2 diabetes not using insulin were randomized to CGM or usual care. CGM improved time in range and modestly lowered HbA1c; device adherence predicted benefit.
